name: Nana Eiyuu Monogatari
source:
Bandits attack a quiet village and kidnap a female magician. The two bravest local warriors are quite unable to protect their homeland by themselves, so they seek the help of a wandering adventurer named Ray. Ray agrees to rescue the girl and teams up with other heroes, each with his or her own motivation for the battle. Eventually, seven heroes travel together on a quest to stop a dangerous person who has forgotten his heritage in search for power.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/nana-eiy-monogatari]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
强盗袭击了一座宁静的村庄，绑走了一名女魔法师。村中最勇敢的两位战士无力独自保卫家园，只好向名叫雷的流浪冒险者求助。雷答应救出女孩，并与其他英雄结成同伴，每个人都有各自战斗的理由。最终，七位英雄携手踏上旅程，阻止一个为追求力量而忘却自身传承的危险人物。

[摘自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/nana-eiy-monogatari]MobyGames[/url]]
